study type: Cohort study (for adults) and retrospective analysis of a prospective study (for newborns)
cohort: The study included two cohorts: young healthy adult volunteers (105 males and 102 females) and newborn infants.
finding: Healthy young adult females exhibit a higher (1.5%) SpO2 compared to their male counterparts, but this sex-linked difference is not observed at birth in newborn infants.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at a single point in time for young adults and at birth for newborn infants.
